title: Where the Resident Funds Coinsurance Reserve Run Begins: Booked Blocks and Coverage Start
content:
Before an ancillary per-bill authorization amount is set on a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account, the spare balance is reduced by a reserve for the coinsurance on the run of the resident's active episode under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage. **The run's first day follows the episode's bookings**, because the reserve covers only the days the coverage office has not booked yet and it books an episode's days block by block:

| Episode records | The run's first day |
|---|---|
| a block of the active episode is booked | the day after the last day of its most recent booked block |
| no block of the active episode is booked yet | the episode's coverage start date |
| no Part A episode is active | there is no run |

## Hypothetical illustration (coverage start 14 January 2026)

| Booked blocks of the episode | Run's first day |
|---|---|
| none yet | 14 January 2026 |
| 14 to 31 January | 1 February 2026 |
| 14 to 31 January and 1 to 28 February | 1 March 2026 |

A block of an earlier episode that has ended is not a block of the active episode.
